messages:
Devon: quick Q — where's the best place to pull a heatmap/route distribution for 4xx spikes? want a dash + raw logs so I can tune alerts for client bursts vs real regressions.

Alex: try the ingress heatmap dash: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress/4xx-heatmap — it shows per-route counts and a timeheat layer. also check the 'route:count' panel for top offending routes.

Mira: if you need logs, filter Loki by `env=prod` and `http_status=~"4.."` and `route=~"/.*"`. example: `{env="prod",http_status=~"4.."} | json | route=route` then count_over_time() bucket.

Sam: for alerts — we moved away from raw count thresholds. instead we use a ratio monitor: `sum(http.status.4xx{env:prod,service:ingress}) / sum(http.requests{env:prod,service:ingress})` rollup by 5m. trigger if > 0.02 for 10m AND p95(latency) stable. that filters client bursts.

Alex: another quick trick: group by `route` in the monitor and only alert if > N routes exceed threshold OR if a single route's 4xx rate rises by >X% vs baseline. prevents noisy api-key failures from paging oncall.

Devon: nice — any concrete DD query you recommend I paste into a monitor?

Mira: example Datadog monitor query (copy/paste):
```
avg(last_5m): 100 * (sum:requests.status.4xx{env:prod}.as_count() / sum:requests.total{env:prod}.as_count()) > 2
```
Then set the scope to `route` and use `notify_no_data: false` + a 10m window.

Sam: add a suppression rule for known bots/healthcheck routes: `exclude:route:/healthcheck` and `exclude:source:internal-cron` in the monitor tags.

Alex: if you want traces, use the trace-id from the ingress logs and open the trace in Jaeger. dash has a quick link in the panel – click a cell to see sample traces.

observability-bot: snapshot posted: https://grafana.redwood.internal/snapshot/abcd1234 (last 6h heatmap) :mag:

Devon: perfect — I'll wire the ratio monitor, scope to route, and add exclusions. if I get noisy alerts I'll ping here and attach a sample trace. thanks! :thumbsup:

Sam: runbook reminder: when alerted, check 1) ingress heatmap 2) top traces 3) SLO page (prod-http-errors) 4) recent deploys. links: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/4xx-triage

Devon: noted — will update the alert with a note pointing to the runbook.

Alex: fyi we also have a weekly job that backfills baselines — use `baseline=rolling_7d` in monitor if you want dynamic thresholds.

Devon: awesome, closing this one after I flip the monitor on. will report back if any surprises.
